question: Which Edition of the European Political Community Summit was held in November 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**5th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **5th Edition** of the European Political Community (EPC) Summit is scheduled to take place in **November 2024**.
 
• The EPC Summit is a platform for fostering political dialogue and cooperation among European countries, including both EU and non-EU members.
 
• It was first launched in 2022, with the inaugural summit held in **Prague, Czech Republic**.
 
• The primary objective of the summit is to address pressing geopolitical challenges, enhance security, and strengthen economic ties across Europe.
 
• The EPC Summit involves leaders from 44 European nations, focusing on shared concerns such as energy security, migration, and infrastructure development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **European Political Community (EPC):**

 
 
• The EPC is a political forum aimed at fostering cooperation between European countries beyond the framework of the EU.
 
• It was proposed by French President Emmanuel Macron in May 2022 to address shared challenges across the continent.
 
 
 
• **Key Themes of the EPC Summit:**
 
 
• Security and defense cooperation to counter geopolitical threats.
 
• Collaborative efforts on energy security and the transition to renewable energy sources.
 
• Addressing migration challenges and enhancing infrastructure connectivity.
 
 
 
• **Inaugural EPC Summit:**
 
 
• The first summit was held on October 6, 2022, in Prague, Czech Republic.
 
• The event brought together leaders from 44 European countries, including non-EU states like the UK and Turkey.
 
 
 
• **Significance of EPC:**
 
 
• Acts as a unifying platform for European nations amidst rising geopolitical tensions and global challenges.
 
• Promotes multilateralism and strengthens Europe’s global standing.
